item.title: About Me
item.description: Hi, I’m chí chěng (池骋): a proud Fuzhou native, a heartbroken Hongkonger in pieces, and a Beijinger in disguise who can never go back. Since September 2022, I’ve been learning how to be Canadian. So far, I have yet to find a place in this world where I would wholeheartedly choose to stay. My life, when it comes down to it, is about two things: writing and connections with people. Nothing compares to the happiness I find in writing what I want to write.
